podcast.body: This song was a top three hit in 1966 and was co-written by Sylvia Moe and Henry Cosby, a staff producer at Motown. Its chorus later became the subject of a lawsuit against Oasis for its similarity to their song "Step Out." "In 1966, Stevie had a top three hit with a song called Uptight Everything's All Right."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

Wonder "won" the dispute, resulting in "Step Out" being removed from all subsequent editions of the Oasis album and Noel Gallagher's royalties being reduced.
